notes: Three new AI-first features (all local Ollama, nothing leaves your PC): (1) 'Why is my PC slow right now?' - live triage snapshot of top CPU/RAM/disk/network offenders with a plain-English narration. (2) Battery coach - unplugged-battery popup names the biggest power drain and offers coaching, with per-discharge-cycle de-duplication. (3) Game and heavy-app narrator - a single Windows toast when a known game launches or a new app becomes resource-heavy, with full Dospara GALLERIA 推奨PC roster coverage including katakana aliases. Non-intrusive by design: all three background daemons now suppress toasts and popups while you are in a fullscreen app (gaming, slideshow, full-screen video), and the heavy-app probe backs off while the CPU is already busy. First-time users see a one-shot help coachmark pointing at the tutorial button. XSS audit converted eleven user-controllable render sites to safe-escape. Seven dead subprocess imports removed. Narrate-only rule enforced: new features never open or close any app, they only describe.
